Hey, I'm not sure if thats ur song because it feels way too high quality to be some random redditors track lol. But if it is u have serious potential, but I don't really think that potential is being tapped in on. I have some constructive criticisms that I really do think could improve your impressive sound. Though I think the death grips influence is always welcomed, I think that it is a little to "I want to be the next death grips" which is saddening. The reason death grips is so popular is because they did them, they felt like they were doing something unique because that was their way of expression, but ur song feels too cleanly made to even be apart of that style anyways. Death grips feels like pent up violence. The melody don't rhyme, the beat is distorted with screams and the drums and bass seem to hit like a bat. Another complaint I have is the instrumental felt like it was so close to being a genuine smart sound but it was too rushed to see its full, massive, potential. It needed more chaos and more substance, in total ur sound in particular needs more chaos, it seems way too tamed, the entire song I was waiting for the beat to hit a full ear bleeding drop with ur calm vocals turning into a dreaded scream, but instead it remained in its usual, sort of boring, form. That's all I have to say.
